floor_history.headline: Confirmed floor 4 (vu32 single-store); killed instance hypothesis that a minimal single-statement body reaches $t9; grant's fold claim only wrong for the volatile reading; sibling has independent hand

Resolved s1 frontier item 1: $t9 IS reachable by genuine register pressure (N>=22 live scratch pseudos, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER override for MIPS), but only at the cost of a 110-insn body with $s0-$s7 save

Two decomp-permuter campaigns (85,461 total iterations, 2 byte-equivalent chassis) found zero novel forms; the $t9 seat and trailing-nop hunks remain unreached by unguided mutation, confirming s1/s2's

Enumerate modality: 16-spelling systematic sweep of the single-store body (decl order/inline, address/value/cast forms, volatile spelling, trailing return) all score 4/5-insns identically -- zero-hit,

Judge-directed TU-boundary shape measured and falsified (original links objects at 4-byte granularity; scratch link gives 0 or 3 pad words, never 1); ruling's 16-align objection refuted (asmpsx pad is

Solver: frame-free $t9 seat class-killed (ascending RA in all three allocators; no $25 RTL producer under -mno-abicalls; 18-step pressure ladder reaches $t9 only at N=23 with a frame); classify's SCHE
Forensics: a reorder-mode hand-asm body (li $25; sw; j $31; nop) reproduces all 6 target words byte-exact through maspsx+as, giving one mechanism for both residual hunks; abicalls reading killed
Rederive modality (m2c, decomp.me corpus, sibling transplant) found nothing new; floor stays 4, residual still the $t9 seat + trailing nop confirmed by --diff as operand-only/source-level.

Object-model audit: func_80052C10 touches zero named globals; its only operand (0x1F800400) is one byte past Unk1F800000Rec's declared end, confirmed by address arithmetic -- no aggregate/split-scalar
Escalation: floor 4 re-measured; scan LOW 0/12, SOTN precedent census 0, cc1psx 4/4 not closer -> rotation record filed per standing ruling 2026-07-27.

frontier.hypothesis: The trailing nop + $t9 seat are a reorder-mode hand-asm signature shared with the 10 other jr;nop;nop functions (Sony asm modules).
frontier.mechanism: same assembler habit (s5 census, s7 byte-exact reproduction)
frontier.next_probe: An owner-approved scanner signal class for this shape would lift the tier to STRONG; not a grind lever.

frontier.hypothesis: An object boundary at 0x80052C24 consistent with the original link could explain the pad word.
frontier.next_probe: Only with new TU-split evidence; s5 scratch link gave 0 or 3 pad words, never 1.

judge_constraints: No canonical-asm keep or grant for func_80052C10 without a gate-class STRONG scan_hand_coded hit (adding a new signal class needs owner approval, so it is not a grind lever). Next C shape: test the trailing nop as a TU boundary, with func_80052C10 ending its own object at 0x80052C24 and the 8-aligned next object starting at 0x80052C28. Measure it in a scratch build. Landing it needs bb2.ld/TU-split surface, so file an integration-handoff with the measurements. Separately, keep hunting the $t9 seat with a structurally different, frame-free chassis. Otherwise the function stays INCLUDE_ASM in the worklist.
